 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

The Petitioner has filed this writ petition challenging the inaction of the Opposite Parties in not extending the benefits of Odisha Resettlement and Rehabilitation Policy, 2006, and under provisions under Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013 to the project affected person though the Petitioner has lost his land for establishment of M/s. Vedant Alumina Refinery Project at Lanjigarh in the district of Kalahandi.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting her grievance, the Petitioner has made representation to Opposite Party No.4 vide Annexures-4 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time, to which learned counsel for the State has no objection.

5. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.4 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-4, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
Jashoda Dalei vs State Of Odisha & Others
